sentences.zh: 今天是2月14日星期二。

sentences.zh: 痛苦不会消散。

sentences.en: It refuses to go away.
sentences.zh: 它挥之不去。

sentences.en: It remains forever implanted in our hearts.
sentences.zh: 它永远留在了我们的心中。

sentences.en: In 1998, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stood amid the ruins of an Auschwitz crematorium where more than a million Jews had been murdered and
sentences.zh: 1998年，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡站在奥斯威辛集中营一座焚尸炉的废墟中，这里曾有上百万犹太人惨遭杀害，

sentences.en: stressed the dire importance of the Jewish state.
sentences.zh: 他强调了犹太国家极其重要的意义。

sentences.en: Evil beyond comprehension.
sentences.zh: 超乎想象的邪恶。

sentences.en: Evil beyond grasp.
sentences.zh: 难以理解的邪恶。

sentences.en: Evil so monstrous that it challenges the elementary faith in humanity.
sentences.zh: 如此骇人听闻的邪恶，挑战着人类最基本的信念。

sentences.en: He was speaking in front of thousands of Jewish teenagers waving Israeli flags, an early stop on a tour that would take these young
sentences.zh: 他是在成千上万挥舞着以色列国旗的犹太青少年前面发表讲话，这是一次行程中的早期一站，这些年轻

sentences.en: people from the concentration camps of Poland, where Judaism nearly met its end, to Israel, where it had been reborn.
sentences.zh: 人将从犹太教几乎走向终结的波兰集中营，前往犹太教重生的以色列。

sentences.en: Among the young men and women in the crowd that day was 17-year-old Jared
sentences.zh: 那天人群中的年轻男女中，有17岁的杰瑞德

sentences.en: Kushner.
sentences.zh: 库什纳。

sentences.en: So he was a pretty normal New Jersey teenager with a couple of really exceptional aspects to his life story.
sentences.zh: 所以他当时是一个相当普通的在新泽西长大的少年，不过他的人生经历中有几个非常特殊的地方。

sentences.en: One was that his grandparents had survived the Holocaust, each in truly grueling fashion.
sentences.zh: 一个是他的祖父母在大屠杀中幸存下来，两人的经历都极其残酷。

sentences.en: And not only that, but they survived.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还活了下来。

sentences.en: And as soon as they came to America, they became wildly successful.
sentences.zh: 而且他们一到美国，就取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: It was kind of the stuff of refugee dreaMs. And they committed themselves to Jewish continuity and survival.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是难民梦想的写照，他们致力于犹太人的延续与生存。

sentences.en: They gave to a dizzying array of Jewish charities, charities in Israel.
sentences.zh: 他们向眼花缭乱的各种犹太慈善机构以及以色列的慈善机构捐款。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 并且

sentences.en: Jared was reared with a real sense of responsibility to assure the Jewish future, a huge connection to
sentences.zh: 杰瑞德在成长过程中被灌输了一种真正的责任感，要确保犹太人的未来，以及与

sentences.en: Israel.
sentences.zh: 以色列建立紧密的联系。

sentences.en: And he was educated in schools that you would call kind of religiously ZioniSt. They taught
sentences.zh: 他所受的教育可以说是带有某种宗教犹太复国主义色彩的学校。他们教导

sentences.en: that support for the state of Israel was not only a kind of political thing, but that it was also almost a religious commandment.
sentences.zh: 说，对以色列国的支持不仅是一种政治上的事情，几乎也是一条宗教诫命。

sentences.en: With Donald Trump's son-in-law now a key advisor in the White House, my colleague Jody Kanner has been
sentences.zh: 随着特朗普的女婿如今成为白宫的核心顾问，我的同事朱迪·坎纳一直在

sentences.en: looking into Kushner's relationship to his Jewish faith, to the leader of Israel, and how those relationships could produce sweeping changes in America's relationship to Israel.
sentences.zh: 调查库什纳与他的犹太信仰、以色列领导人之间的关系，以及这些关系将如何对美国与以色列的关系带来巨大的改变。

sentences.en: So this vivid scene of Jared standing on this incredibly significant site for the Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是杰瑞德站在对犹太人民具有极其重大意义的地点的一个生动场景。

sentences.en: Every site and every step reminds us of what happened here.
sentences.zh: 每一个地点和每一步都在提醒我们这里发生过什么。

sentences.en: Listening to Bibi Netanyahu deliver this speech, there's just so much going on there.
sentences.zh: 听着比比·内塔尼亚胡发表这篇演讲，里面包含的信息实在是太多了。

sentences.en: What exactly do you make of it?
sentences.zh: 你究竟是怎么看这件事的？

sentences.en: Well, Netanyahu is in a way enacting the kind of religious Zionism that Kushner was raised with his whole life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，内塔尼亚胡在某种程度上正在演绎库什纳从小到大所接触的那种宗教犹太复国主义。

sentences.en: I want to tell you what you couldn't hear on that tape, which is that before Netanyahu starts, he dons a white prayer shawl.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你你在录音里听不到的内容，那就是在内塔尼亚胡开始之前，他披上了一条白色的祈祷披肩。

sentences.en: It's stark white.
sentences.zh: 它是纯白色的。

sentences.en: It's like a shroud.
sentences.zh: 就像一件殓衣。

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Shema Yisrael.
sentences.zh: 以色列啊，听我说。

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: The sort of core prayer of the Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 犹太人民的核心祈祷文。

sentences.en: In other words, he's giving kind of a religious speech, right?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他发表的其实是一种宗教演讲，对吧？

sentences.en: He's not just giving like another political prime minister speech.
sentences.zh: 他不仅仅是在发表另一场政治总理演讲。

sentences.en: More than half a century has passed.
sentences.zh: 半个多世纪已经过去了。

sentences.en: He talks first about how...
sentences.zh: 他首先谈到……

sentences.en: And we can still hear the last cries, the final prayers.
sentences.zh: 我们依然能听到最后的哭喊声和最后的祈祷。

sentences.en: Even 50 years later, they can still hear the cries of their relatives as they're sent to the death chambers.
sentences.zh: 即使在50年后，他们依然能听到亲人们被送往死亡集中营时的哭喊声。

sentences.en: The gasps of our brothers and sisters, our flesh and blood, the old and the young who perished here.
sentences.zh: 我们兄弟姐妹的喘息声，我们的骨肉至亲，在这里遇难的老人和孩子。

sentences.en: And then he kind of lowers the boom.
sentences.zh: 然后他抛出了一个重磅观点。

sentences.en: He says, And we know today that the Holocaust could have been prevented.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们今天知道，大屠杀本是可以避免的。

sentences.en: We know it could not have taken place had the Jewish state been established a few years earlier.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，如果犹太国家早几年建立，这一切就不会发生。

sentences.en: He's saying that this is sort of fundamentally the key to Jewish survival.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，这基本上是犹太人生存的关键。

sentences.en: Well, Jared had heard that message his entire life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，杰瑞德一生都听过这种信息。

sentences.en: People should know what happened to us.
sentences.zh: 人们应该知道我们身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: If we're not going to tell now, in 20 years, I don't know who's going to be to tell.
sentences.zh: 如果我们现在不讲，20年后，我不知道还有谁会去讲。

sentences.en: You mentioned his grandparents and their experience in the HolocauSt. What exactly was it?
sentences.zh: 你提到了他的祖父母以及他们在集中营的经历。那到底是怎样的经历？

sentences.en: Well, I've never heard a Holocaust survival story that wasn't dramatic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从未听说过哪段大屠杀生还的故事是不具戏剧性的。

sentences.en: But these two have an especially kind of brutal ring to them.
sentences.zh: 但这两个人的经历听起来格外残酷。

sentences.en: Suffice it to say that Ray Kushner, his grandmother, she survived in part by crawling through a homey tunnel in the ground that was hundreds of feet long.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他的祖母雷·库什纳能够生还，部分原因是她爬过了一条长达数百英尺、位于地下的简陋地道。

sentences.en: His grandfather survived in part by living in a hole in the earth for a period of three years.
sentences.zh: 他的祖父能够生还，部分原因是在地下的一个洞里生活了三年之久。

sentences.en: So these were people who really clawed their way out of Europe.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人真的是拼死逃出了欧洲。

sentences.en: That's extremely powerful.
sentences.zh: 这太震撼了。

sentences.en: This was only one of many, many, many times in Jared Kushner's life where he was told that Israel was essential to the survival of the Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 这只是杰瑞德·库什纳一生中无数次被告知以色列对犹太人民生存至关重要的其中一次。

sentences.en: That scene in Auschwitz in Poland, it seems like that marks the first moment of connection between Jared Kushner and Bibi Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 波兰奥斯威辛的那个场景，似乎标志着杰瑞德·库什纳和比比·内塔尼亚胡之间产生联系的第一个时刻。

sentences.en: No, in fact, the connection goes deeper than that.
sentences.zh: 不，事实上，他们之间的联系比那还要深。

sentences.en: Oh?
sentences.zh: 哦？

sentences.en: That day at Auschwitz, Jared was really just another face in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 在奥斯威辛的那天，杰瑞德其实只是人群中的一张普通面孔。

sentences.en: There were thousands and thousands of Jewish teenagers who had gathered there.
sentences.zh: 当时有成千上万聚集在那里的犹太青少年。

sentences.en: But what was unique about Jared is that he actually knew the prime minister.
sentences.zh: 但杰瑞德的独特之处在于他其实认识这位总理。

sentences.en: His family has had a relationship with Netanyahu for a long time, just a couple of years before.
sentences.zh: 他的家族与内塔尼亚胡有着长期的交往，就在几年之前，

sentences.en: Netanyahu had come to visit his family in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡曾来新泽西拜访过他的家人。

sentences.en: Netanyahu had actually stayed with the Kushners.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡实际上就住在库什纳家。

sentences.en: Extraordinary fact.
sentences.zh: 非同寻常的事实。

sentences.en: No, wait.
sentences.zh: 不，等等。

sentences.en: It's much more than that.
sentences.zh: 还不止于此。

sentences.en: But he stayed in Jared's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他住的是杰瑞德的卧室。

sentences.en: Where did Jared stay?
sentences.zh: 那杰瑞德住哪？

sentences.en: In the basement.
sentences.zh: 在地下室。

sentences.en: Why is the prime minister of Israel in the Kushner's house in New Jersey?
sentences.zh: 为什么以色列总理会住在新泽西库什纳的家里？

sentences.en: Well, here's what is and isn't unusual.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是不寻常与寻常的地方。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for Netanyahu to hobnob with prominent Jews.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡与杰出犹太人交际并不算不寻常。

sentences.en: What is unusual for this kind of ordinary American Jewish kid to have a relationship with the prime minister of Israel.
sentences.zh: 不寻常的是这样一个普通的美国犹太小孩竟然能和以色列总理建立联系。

sentences.en: So when you think about this week's White House meeting, this is not the first time these two men have encountered each other.
sentences.zh: 所以当你想到本周的白宫会晤时，这并不是这两个人第一次相遇。

sentences.en: So let's catch ourselves up.
sentences.zh: 让我们回顾一下。

sentences.en: It's 19 years after this encounter in Poland.
sentences.zh: 那是波兰那次相遇的19年之后。

sentences.en: And today we find ourselves in this pretty remarkable situation, which is that that young kid is now Jared Kushner,
sentences.zh: 而今天我们发现自己处在这样一个非常奇妙的境地，那个年轻的孩子现在成了杰瑞德·库什纳，

sentences.en: the presidential advisor who's been asked to make peace in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 也就是那位被委任在中东实现和平的总统顾问。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu is once again the prime minister of Israel and therefore the person that Kushner would be negotiating with.
sentences.zh: 而内塔尼亚胡再次成为以色列总理，因此也是库什纳将要进行谈判的对象。

sentences.en: What is the relationship right now today?
sentences.zh: 他们现在的关系究竟如何？

sentences.en: It's a really warm one, especially when you contrast it with the relationship between the Obama White House and the Netanyahu administration.
sentences.zh: 关系非常融洽，特别是当你把它与奥巴马白宫和内塔尼亚胡政府之间的关系进行对比时。

sentences.en: This week's meeting has much more of a feeling of like-minded people coming together.
sentences.zh: 本周的会晤更有那种志同道合的人聚在一起的感觉。

sentences.en: There's an enormous amount of truSt.
sentences.zh: 这里有着极大的信任。

sentences.en: It's like an entirely different flavor than the Obama administration's pronouncements on Israel.
sentences.zh: 这与奥巴马政府对以色列的表态有着完全不同的风格。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the Obama administration approach.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈奥巴马政府的方法。

sentences.en: This was not a presidency built around strong personal ties like what Jared has.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个建立在杰瑞德那种强烈的个人纽带之上的总统任期。

sentences.en: And so how did that look?
sentences.zh: 那么情况是怎样的呢？

sentences.en: Obama's policies ran contrary to Netanyahu, right?
sentences.zh: 奥巴马的政策与内塔尼亚胡背道而驰，对吧？

sentences.en: Obama tried to say to Netanyahu, you have got to stand up to the settler movement.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马曾试图对内塔尼亚胡说，你必须挺身对抗定居点运动。

sentences.en: You've got to stop building.
sentences.zh: 你必须停止建设。

sentences.en: This is an obstacle to peace.
sentences.zh: 这是和平的障碍。

sentences.en: You're taking a bad problem and you're making it worse.
sentences.zh: 你是在把一个本已糟糕的问题弄得更糟。

sentences.en: And I'm going to use the pressure and the power of the American presidency to get you to stop.
sentences.zh: 我将利用美国总统的压力和权力来阻止你。

sentences.en: The Trump administration seems to be saying something totally different, which is we're deemphasizing the settlements.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府似乎在表达完全不同的观点，那就是我们正在淡化定居点问题。

sentences.en: The settlements are something to be negotiated over in a final agreement, but they're not like the essential dynamics.
sentences.zh: 定居点是在最终协议中进行谈判的事情，但它们并不是核心动态。

sentences.en: That's holding the Middle East back.
sentences.zh: 那在拖累中东的发展。

sentences.en: So let's talk about Jared Kushner's father-in-law, our president, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈杰瑞德·库什纳的岳父，我们的总统唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: What exactly is his relationship in thinking about Israel?
sentences.zh: 他在对以色列的看法上究竟是什么关系？

sentences.en: We know that Netanyahu is probably Donald Trump's closest foreign ally at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我们知道内塔尼亚胡可能是目前唐纳德·特朗普最亲密的外国盟友。

sentences.en: How much does that have to do with Jared?
sentences.zh: 这跟杰瑞德有多大关系？

sentences.en: In other words, without Jared, would Donald Trump be this close to Israel?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果没有杰瑞德，唐纳德·特朗普会和以色列这么亲近吗？

sentences.en: Would he even really care this much about Israel?
sentences.zh: 他甚至真的会这么关心以色列吗？

sentences.en: I think you're asking exactly the right question.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你问到了点子上。

sentences.en: This president's views on Israel very much seem like a function of what Jared channels to his father-in-law.
sentences.zh: 这位总统对以色列的看法，很大程度上似乎是杰瑞德向岳父传达内容的产物。

sentences.en: And we can actually see in our reporting, we can see the process unfold.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上可以在我们的报道中看到这个过程的展开。

sentences.en: When Trump made a big speech to the American-Israel Public Affairs Committee, to AIPAC as a candidate, what happened is Jared wrote a lot of the speech.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普作为候选人向美以公共事务委员会（AIPAC）发表长篇大论时，发生的情况是杰瑞德撰写了演讲的大部分内容。

sentences.en: I speak to you today as a lifelong supporter and true friend of Israel.
sentences.zh: 我今天作为以色列的终身支持者和真诚朋友对你们讲话。

sentences.en: He was speaking with people like the Israeli ambassador, Ron Dermer, all the time.
sentences.zh: 他一直都在与像以色列驻美大使罗恩·德默这样的人交流。

sentences.en: They put together a speech.
sentences.zh: 他们拼凑出了一篇演讲稿。

sentences.en: Trump gave it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普发表了它。

sentences.en: When I'm president, believe me, I will veto any attempt by the UN to impose its will on the Jewish state.
sentences.zh: 当我成为总统时，相信我，我会否决联合国任何试图将自己的意志强加给犹太国家的企图。

sentences.en: It will be vetoed 100%.
sentences.zh: 100%会被否决。

sentences.en: You know, those are now sort of taken as Trump's views on Israel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些现在基本上被视为特朗普对以色列的看法。

sentences.en: And yet, the idea of a 36-year-old with no government experience, as you've documented,
sentences.zh: 然而，正如你所记录的，一个没有政府经验的36岁年轻人，
